the present experimental data on baryon masses and magnetic moments, when interpreted in the light of the simple quark models with chiral symmetry, are consistent with a constituent mass of 350-375 MeV for the up quark, 450-475 MeV for the strange quark, and 550-580 MeV for the down quark.
